newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Eletropaulo started. [CORRECTED 16:51 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Eletropaulo started. [CORRECTED 16:51 GMT]

text.p: UBS Securities analyst Sonia Olinto started coverage of Brazilian power utility Eletropaulo SA Friday with a rating of buy.
-- "In our view, Eletropaulo is the power distributor best positioned to succeed in a more competitive electricity market in Brazil," Olinto wrote in a report.
-- "... We believe that Eletropaulo's stock price is still inexpensive in the face of potential efficiency gains that should take place within one year after the company is privatized."
-- The company's preferred B shares were off 4 reais to 304 reais in Sao Paulo (corrects price and change).
